longTitle.officialTitle: To reauthorize the Traumatic Brain Injury program.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Traumatic Brain Injury Program Reauthorization Act of 2018”.

section.heading: PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INJURIES.
section.chapeau: Part J of title III of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280b et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.content: in section 394A(b)(42 U.S.C. 280b-3(b)), by striking “$6,564,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2019” and inserting “$11,750,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024”; and

section.heading: STATE GRANTS FOR PROJECTS REGARDING TRAUMATIC BRAIN INJURY.
section.chapeau: Section 1252 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-52) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a), by inserting “, acting through the Administrator for the Administration for Community Living,” after “The Secretary”;
by redesignating subsections (f) through (j) as subsections (e) through (i), respectively; and
in subsection (i), as so redesignated, by striking “$5,500,000 for each of the fiscal years 2015 through 2019” and inserting “$7,321,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024”.

section.heading: STATE GRANTS FOR PROTECTION AND ADVOCACY SERVICES.
section.chapeau: Section 1253 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-53) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a), by inserting “, acting through the Administrator for the Administration for Community Living,” after “The Secretary”; and
in subsection (l), by striking “$3,100,000 for each of the fiscal years 2015 through 2019” and inserting “$4,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024”.
